title: Central Teke language - Wikipedia
text: Central Teke is a member of the Teke languages dialect continuum of the Congolese plateau. Central Teke dialects are Ngungwel and Mpu, Boo, and Nzikou. They are spoken in the Malebo Pool region of the Republic of Congo, with an unknown number of Boo speakers in DRC.

title: Ngungwel | Ethnologue Free
text: Ngungwel is a stable indigenous language of Congo. It belongs to the Niger-Congo language family. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
